title: Financial Assistance for School Canteen Operators Given Home-based Learning
what_it_is: Financial Assistance for School Canteen Operators Given Home-based Learning

sections.label: MOE school canteen rental waivers
sections.summary: MOE granted school canteen operators rental waivers in 2020 and 2021, with about 2,380 stallholders today, down from 2,410 in 2020.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: To support school canteen operators whose businesses may have been affected by safe management measures arising from the COVID-19 situation, the Ministry of Education (MOE) has been granting rental waivers for the affected periods, in line with the rental waivers provided for qualifying tenants in commercial properties owned by Government agencies at the national level in 2020 and 2021.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: In 2020, MOE granted a four-month rental waiver for the months of April to August 2020.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: For 2021, we have granted two months of rental waiver for the months of May and July 2021, during Phase Two (Heightened Alert), and will be extending another half-month of rental waiver in October as part of the Government's support for sectors affected by the recent tightened measures.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: Today, there are about 2,380 school canteen stallholders across our Government and Government-aided schools, a slight decrease from the 2,410 in 2020.

sections.label: Canteen operators COVID-19 Recovery Grant
sections.summary: School canteen operators and their employed assistants can qualify for the COVID-19 Recovery Grant if they meet the qualifying criteria.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: School canteen operators are considered self-employed persons and the school canteen assistants employed by the operators are also considered for COVID-19 Recovery Grant (CRG) if they meet the qualifying criteria.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: So, to answer the Member's question, both the canteen operators as well as the assistants that they employ can qualify for CRG if they meet the qualifying criteria.
